provenance.capture_devices: 2023 14-inch MacBook Pro speakers; iPhone 14 Pro Max / Voice Memos

plan.hypothesis_status: Post-hoc diagnostic prompted by severe frozen real-acoustic failure; not confirmatory SOTA.
plan.algorithm: Per-pair centered log(max(reference_whole_crop_mean_mel,1e-6)/max(phone_whole_crop_mean_mel,1e-6)); coordinatewise median across552 known calibration queries; recenter32 log gains to mean0; exponentiate; no clipping/smoothing/weighting.
plan.helpfulness_criterion: Both rawcorrect and acceptedcorrect calibration-known counts strictly improve vs frozen exactD8, each at its independent627-negative1% gate.
plan.heldout_scoring_rule: Once only after gain+gate freeze and helpfulness criterion passes; otherwise retain calibration-only null.

timing_caveat: Concurrent jobs; no latency claim; calibration hypothesis is post-hoc.

fma_overlap_sensitivity.caution: Different source namespaces or absent encoded-byte/title equality do not prove distinct compositions or absence of transformed-recording/pretraining exposure.

uncertainty: 5000 deterministic source-cluster bootstrap draws; conditional on recorded sessions. Four sessions and one declared capture-device pair do not support a device/room-population claim.
